• Orchestrated strategic alignment for B2B FinTech product development across a 50+ member cross-functional team, enhancing delivery efficiency by 15% despite inherent communication silos across global functions.
  • Directed the critical iPay FinTech product launch, achieving 95% on-time completion and capturing 10% market share amidst intense market competition and evolving regulatory demands within a dynamic payments landscape.
  • Managed four complex Third-Party API Integrations for critical payment systems, accelerating feature delivery by 15% and ensuring 100% payments control within a dynamic regulatory framework.
  • Formulated comprehensive Project Charters and Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), boosting product clarity by 30% and proactively resolving technical ambiguities for engineering teams.
  • Executed AI-powered solutions to optimize merchant onboarding flows, significantly reducing Turnaround Time (TAT) by 30% through automated verification services, directly addressing a critical business bottleneck.
  • Supervised over 15 User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles, increasing user acquisition by 20% and enhancing overall product quality for key FinTech offerings, despite tight release schedules.

• Championed product roadmaps for seven B2B/B2C SaaS platforms, achieving 300% revenue growth and securing significant market share despite evolving market demands and fierce competitive pressures.
  • Streamlined product feature delivery using SAFe Agile (Kanban & Scrum) methodologies, increasing sprint speed by 35% across multiple engineering teams with varying priorities and technical dependencies.
  • Engineered AI & API integration for the IRIS Loan Management System (LMS), elevating user engagement by 30% and successfully navigating initial adoption resistance through targeted A/B testing and SQL-driven insights.
  • Spearheaded the IRIS LMS version upgrade, integrating advanced AI/ML workflow features and leveraging MLOps CI/CD pipelines to accelerate model release cycles by 40% under tight deadlines and complex architectural constraints.
  • Cultivated strong stakeholder alignment with over 20 key enterprise clients, ensuring 100% satisfaction and adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) through proactive communication and robust vendor management.
  • Authored comprehensive Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) and UI screens for over 10 strategic initiatives, generating ₹4.5 Crore in new business and optimizing critical conversion funnels, despite significant resource limitations.
  • Coordinated the full ISO 27001:2022 and enterprise software audit process, achieving 100% compliance within an aggressive timeline & establishing a robust security posture along with Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023.

• Crafted over 10 unique sales assets using Salesforce, increasing utilization by 20% for AI automation portfolios and resolving critical challenges with outdated sales collateral.
  • Analyzed over 30 top-tier accounts, identifying ₹5 Crore in potential revenue through strategic segmentation and data-backed decision-making for enterprise solutions.

• End-to-End Placement Process Management: Managed placement preparedness, logistics, and execution for 1,000+ students and 200+ recruiting companies, ensuring seamless coordination among all stakeholders.

  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Engaged with recruiters, students, faculty, and alumni to understand requirements, resolve queries, and maintain professional relationships to support successful placements.

  • Industry Networking & Relationship Building: Cultivated connections with industry leaders, alumni, and corporate recruiters to expand the placement network and unlock new opportunities for the student body.

  • Problem Solving & Decision Making: Resolved real-time challenges such as schedule conflicts, last-minute interview modifications, and employer-specific requests to ensure uninterrupted placement operations.

  • Strategic Planning for Placement Drives: Contributed to the design and execution of placement strategies that aligned company hiring needs with student skill sets, enhancing the effectiveness of placement drives.

Overall, this role sharpened my ability to operate at the intersection of people, process, and strategy, a skill set I continue to leverage in my career across Product Management, Project Delivery, and AI Consulting engagements.

• Led Digital Transformation consulting initiatives to enhance online presence and user engagement.
  • Oversaw the planning, design, and launch of the business's landing page, ensuring alignment with brand identity and customer journey.
  • Implemented data collection mechanisms (such as contact forms, lead magnets, and tracking tools) to capture valuable customer insights.
  • Integrated a secure and seamless payment gateway solution, enabling smooth online transactions and improving user trust.
  • Coordinated with cross-functional teams including design, development, and marketing to ensure timely delivery and functionality.

• Developed comprehensive Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria for core B2B SaaS data workflows serving 100M+ users, collaborating with engineering to boost platform scalability by 20% despite technical legacy constraints.
  • Collaborated with UX/UI designers in Figma to wireframe and prototype intuitive user flows for three web applications, significantly cutting user friction and improving page load speeds by 25%, overcoming complex user experience challenges.
  • Guided cross-functional execution for two complex database migrations, coordinating across seven global engineering and QA teams to maintain 99.9% data integrity with zero downtime during a critical system overhaul.
  • Prioritized sprint backlog grooming and Agile ceremonies across 20+ releases, accelerating feature delivery timelines by 15% while enforcing rigorous QA standards and managing evolving requirements.
  • Established robust stakeholder alignment via monthly roadmap reviews and Jira tracking, proactively surfacing delivery risks early to sustain a 90% client satisfaction rate under continuous product evolution.

• Assisted in the development and maintenance of company websites, ensuring their functionality, responsiveness, and user experience.
  • Collaborated with the web development team to translate design mock-ups into functional web pages using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Implemented requested changes and resolved technical issues to optimize website performance and usability.
  • Conducted quality assurance testing to identify and fix bugs, ensuring smooth website functionality across different browsers and devices.
  • Assisted in content management tasks, including uploading and updating website content using content management systems (CMS).
